Name: (AT) Purple Mushroom
Author: marielf
Description:
I thought it was a little strange what we got Wizard's Furniture Catalog with red potted mushroom, because we all know that Rasmodius loves purple mushroom, so I changed the existing icon a little, and at the same time I decided to add the ability to have a Junimo Lamp in the form of a purple mushroom.

So using the [b]Paint Bucket[/b] tool from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod you can now change Ornate Lamp and Globe to Junimo's Purple Lamp and Potted Purple Mushroom respectively.



I tried to change the Potted Red Mushroom and Junimo Lamp icons directly, but I think because they are in catalogs I can’t change them separately from other catalog items. If anyone knows how to fix this, please contact me.

Also, if anyone wants to make a version of this mod using Content Patcher, you can do it, but please let me know.
